summary: Browse films and series, see where they stream, and watch from your own sources.
description: A corner of iRiS to browse Cinemeta's films and series by popularity, rating, year and genre, and follow them. A title's page says where it streams officially (TMDB, with your own key); Watch plays in mpv from the sources you add yourself (a Stremio add-on by its address, or a source file), with OpenSubtitles filling a missing language, and resumes where you stopped. It comes with no video sources.
